reason: The plugin primarily improves session-list navigation by generating persistent session topics and adding session-size information to the hover card, with documented log writes, HTTP endpoints, and UI patching.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话自动生成并重试主题标题，并在会话列表悬停卡片中显示会话日志大小。
summaries.en: Automatically generates and retries DeepSeek Harness session topics and displays durable session log size in the session-list hover card.

capabilities: Generates and retries LLM-based session topic titles
Appends generated titles to session logs
Exposes HTTP endpoints for session size lookup and manual sweeps
Patches the session-list hover card to display durable log size
